title: agoseris barbellulata
intro: Agoseris barbellulata, commonly known as the Mountain Daisy or White Pygmy, is a perennial wildflower plant native to the western regions of North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Agoseris barbellulata include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it a valuable remedy for soothing coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
